scope: Existing three waiting roots and archived routes. No new dates or pulls.
physical_contract: Use the actual observed departure second and legal visible menu. Never round the passenger clock, make an unobserved departure available, or read an actual future event.
model: Projection interpolates scores over the old minute-grid brackets; anchor rebuilds the observed trip with the existing exact receipt conditioning on an expanded grid. Both retain V16 waiting heuristic. Neither extends the old bounds to a new timestamp model.
censor: Source-safe replay refuses to infer absence of an unresolved extra candidate once boarding becomes possible. Baseline and downstream source audits use existing V13 rules. Recorded-only is sensitivity conditional on no unrecorded extra departure while waiting. The separate invariance audit checks every integer clock for each missing extra through the first recorded rescue and identifies its replay result only if none could change the action.
latency: Preparation is charged at publication. Decision CPU and wall are recorded. Exact-second actions follow the existing ideal event response contract. On-demand anchor timing does not establish boardability if a deployment has zero dwell or a stricter physical reaction deadline.
